observationMethod: scripts/performance-collect.mjs#observeEnvironmentProfile, reading cgroup v1 (cpu.cfs_quota_us/cpu.cfs_period_us, memory.limit_in_bytes) inside the container — not os.cpus()/os.totalmem(), which report the host even when constrained
note: Network is the host's Docker bridge, not a measured 100 Mbps/20ms link — this dimension of the declared profile is unverified by this run.
